$comment: Generováno `node scripts/license-gate.mjs --sync`. library se odvozuje z lockfilu; asset, model, dataset a api se píšou ručně a sync je nechává být. aiGenerated je ruční oddíl DISCLOSURE.md o kódu a assetech od AI.
aiGenerated: **Code.** The code, tests, scripts and documentation in this repository were written with AI coding assistants – Claude (Anthropic, through Claude Code) and Codex (OpenAI, through the Codex CLI) – under the direction of the author, who set the goals, reviewed the results and decided what was merged. The assistants are development tools only: they are not part of the product and the demo never calls them.

**Games at play time.** The game spec behind every game is AI-generated: a language model reads the player's sentence and picks the pieces, rules and goal from the project's own library. The primary director is gpt-oss-20b (OpenAI open weights, Apache-2.0) on Groq's hosted API, and the paid fallback is gpt-6-astra through the OpenAI API. gpt-6-astra may also read the player's sentence for the AI version that the director builds in the background; the first game shown never waits for it and is built from the words. All of these are configured by the deployment's environment; without them the demo builds a draft game from the words alone and calls no model. The 3D models, sounds and backdrops a game shows come from the asset library below, not from a model at play time. The one exception is the optional local panorama service (`ops/env/server.py`, FLUX.2-klein-4B on the author's GPU), which paints a backdrop the library lacks; the deployed demo does not use it and falls back to the nearest pre-generated panorama.

**Generated assets.** These files were made by AI models in the project's own offline pipelines and are AI-generated: the 3D models in `public/assets/worldstream/gen3d` and `public/assets/worldstream/gen3d-p37d` by `ops/gen3d` (FLUX.2-klein-4B text-to-image, BiRefNet background removal, TRELLIS.2-4B image-to-3D, run locally through ComfyUI); the panorama backdrops in `public/assets/worldstream/env` and `public/play/env` by `ops/env` (FLUX.2-klein-4B); the music loops and sound effects in `public/assets/worldstream/audio` by `ops/audio` (ACE-Step 1.5, MOSS-SoundEffect). Each file is listed under „Vlastní, ne třetí strana“ with the licence `LicenseRef-Worldsmith-Generated`, and every model that made them is in the Modely table with its licence.

**AI-written geometry.** Models marked `Codex-assisted original geometry` (`scripts/assets/originals.mjs`) and `AI-assisted original geometry (Blender)` (`scripts/assets/blender/game_models.py`) are built from primitive shapes by code an AI assistant wrote; no generative 3D model and no third-party geometry is involved. Everything else in the asset library is CC0 from Kenney, Quaternius and Kay Lousberg, plus the Roboto fonts (Apache-2.0) and the Sayplay brand kit, none of it AI-generated by this project.

entries.name: claude-cli
entries.reason: Není to model, ale označení cesty v měřidle evals/play/p58b/compare.measure.ts (P58B T2): „claude-cli:opus“ = claude-opus-5-5 přes claude -p na předplatné, jen jako strop kvality při srovnání čteček. Model sám má vlastní položku claude-opus-5-5.

entries.name: claude-code
entries.license: komerční podmínky služby (Anthropic Commercial Terms); lokální běh na uživatelském předplatném Claude
requiredNotices: žádné pro volajícího; výstupy modelu podléhají podmínkám služby
entries.reviewNote: Není to model, ale CLI, přes které scripts/p37d/judge-sheet.mjs (--judge claude, P46F) volá claude-opus-5-5; jméno je v cestě k binárce @anthropic-ai/claude-code. Jen nástroj vývoje knihovny modelů, produkt ho nevolá.

entries.name: claude-opus-5
requiredNotices: žádné pro volajícího; výstupy modelu podléhají podmínkám služby
entries.reviewNote: Od 6. 9. 2026 se NEVOLÁ a produktu se neúčastní. Do té chvíle stál v src/model/prompt.ts jako EMISSION_MODEL a proxy vracela pod tím jménem odpovědi gpt-5.6-sol; emisní cesta proto jmenuje ten model přímo. Položka zůstává, protože identifikátor je pořád v kódu — v testech a fixturách (evals/harness/**, evals/worldstream/__tests__/**, scripts/__tests__/**).

entries.name: claude-opus-5-5
entries.license: komerční podmínky služby (Anthropic Commercial Terms); lokální běh na uživatelském předplatném Claude přes claude -p
requiredNotices: žádné pro volajícího; výstupy modelu podléhají podmínkám služby
entries.reviewNote: Od 12. 10. 2026 (P46F) slepý soudce generovaných 3D modelů a předkontrola obrázku před TRELLIS: scripts/p37d/judge-sheet.mjs --judge claude, prázdný adresář jen s obrázkem, nástroj jen Read. Odpověď (jméno předmětu) rozhoduje, jestli model jde do knihovny; do knihovny ani do trénovacích dat se z ní nic nepíše. Produkt ho nevolá. Od 23. 10. 2026 (P58B T3) i kandidát na čtečku vět: evals/play/p58b/compare.measure.ts ho volá přes placené Anthropic Messages API s klíčem majitele a stropem --cap-usd; jen měření, výstupy nikdy do trénovacích dat ani příkladů v promptu.

entries.name: claude-sonnet-5
entries.reason: Doslovný identifikátor v src/server/__tests__/upstream.test.ts: test předává změněné model ID mock transportu a ověřuje request body. Tato položka neprohlašuje volání modelu Anthropic v lokálním subscription demu ani existenci modelu tohoto jména.

entries.name: DINOv3 ViT-L (TRELLIS.2 image encoder)
requiredNotices: a copy of the DINOv3 License with any redistributed DINO Materials (none are redistributed)
acknowledge the use of DINO Materials in research publications
entries.reviewNote: Custom model license, RULES.md §4 'check manually' class. Read 2026-09-24: non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free; commercial use permitted; prohibited uses are military/warfare, nuclear, espionage, weapons and ITAR / trade-control end uses. Not non-commercial and not research-only. Owner's decision, 2026-09-29: accepted – commercial use is permitted, and a browser game falls under none of the prohibited uses. The weights stay on the author's machine and are not redistributed.

entries.name: FLUX.2-klein-4B
requiredNotices: license text and NOTICE if the weights are redistributed (they are not)
entries.reviewNote: Default text-to-image step of ops/gen3d (config.toml image_model = "klein"). Only the 4B variant is Apache-2.0 – the 9B variant is non-commercial and is not used. License read from the model card, 2026-09-24.

entries.name: gemini-9-pro
entries.reason: vymyšlený identifikátor v scripts/__tests__/submission-check-gate.test.ts. Produkt žádný model Google nevolá; zapsat ho jako třetí stranu by bylo nepravdivé tvrzení o tom, co projekt používá.

entries.name: gpt-5.6-luna
entries.license: Podmínky příslušné služby OpenAI; tento lokální běh používá uživatelské předplatné ChatGPT/Codex. Ověření podmínek pro veřejné soutěžní nasazení: MISSING.
requiredNotices: žádné pro volajícího; výstupy modelu podléhají podmínkám služby

entries.name: OpenAI Chat Completions API
requiredNotices: žádné pro volajícího; výstupy modelu podléhají podmínkám služby
entries.reviewNote: Paid fallback of the director (gpt-6-astra): called only when the deployment sets WORLDSMITH_FALLBACK_ENDPOINT=openai:https://api.openai.com with the owner's key, under its own spend cap, and only after the primary director failed or stalled. Without that configuration the product never calls it. The game spec it returns is AI-generated output. P58B T3 also sends the dev sentences to gpt-6-astra here to compare sentence readers (evals/play/p58b/compare.measure.ts, --cap-usd spend cap); measurement only. Since P58B T4 gpt-6-astra here is also the sentence reader of the AI version: called only when the deployment sets PLAY_READER=on, PLAY_READER_PATH=ai and PLAY_READER_ENDPOINT=openai:https://api.openai.com with the owner's key, under the reader's own spend cap (PLAY_READER_SPEND_CAP_USD, PLAY_READER_CALL_CAP) and a daily count per caller, by the background director; the answer cache keeps a reading for 7 days and a paid reading that failed (timeout, invalid or cut-off answer) for 10 minutes, so a repeat of the sentence does not pay again within that time, but two reads of the same sentence that overlap in time may each pay, and a reading that failed is paid again after 10 minutes; the fast draft never waits for it and plays from the words. The reading it returns is AI-generated output.
